Package io.github.pimak.ntfy.log4j2

Class NtfyLog4j2Appender.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.apache.logging.log4j.core.filter.AbstractFilterable.Builder<NtfyLog4j2Appender.Builder>
org.apache.logging.log4j.core.appender.AbstractAppender.Builder<NtfyLog4j2Appender.Builder>
io.github.pimak.ntfy.log4j2.NtfyLog4j2Appender.Builder
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.logging.log4j.core.util.Builder<NtfyLog4j2Appender>
Enclosing class:
NtfyLog4j2Appender
public static class NtfyLog4j2Appender.Builder extends org.apache.logging.log4j.core.appender.AbstractAppender.Builder<NtfyLog4j2Appender.Builder> implements org.apache.logging.log4j.core.util.Builder<NtfyLog4j2Appender>
Plugin builder for the <Ntfy .../> element. name, filter and ignoreExceptions come from AbstractAppender.Builder; everything below is ntfy's own.

Every attribute is typed String on purpose. log4j2 leaves an absent attribute at its field default, so a primitive int/boolean field would arrive as 0/false and be indistinguishable from an operator who really wrote maxStackFrames="0" or enabled="false" — silently clobbering ntfy-core's defaults. A String stays null when unset, so the corresponding NtfyConfig.Builder setter is applied ONLY when the operator actually supplied a value. This is the same "boxed, applied only when set" logic the Logback appender uses.

Malformed values never throw during logging initialization: each parse is guarded, warns on the StatusLogger, and leaves the core default in place.

    • setWarnTopic

      public NtfyLog4j2Appender.Builder setWarnTopic(String warnTopic)
      The topic WARN-level events are published to. A non-blank value is the entire opt-in for WARN alerting: unset (the default), this appender alerts on ERROR and above only. It also lowers the level NtfyLog4j2Installer attaches the appender at, so warnings actually reach it. Set it to the same value as topic to alert on warnings through the main topic at a different priority.
      Parameters:
      warnTopic - the ntfy topic for warnings, or null to keep alerting ERROR-only
      Returns:
      this builder

    • build

      public NtfyLog4j2Appender build()
      Instantiates the appender. Returns null — log4j2's contract for "this element cannot be built", which drops the appender with a status error instead of failing the whole configuration — when no name was given.
      Specified by:
      build in interface org.apache.logging.log4j.core.util.Builder<NtfyLog4j2Appender>
      Returns:
      the configured, not-yet-started appender, or null when unbuildable
